game.bridge.name: Bridge
game.bridge.desc: The classic partnership card game: bid for the contract, expose the dummy hand and take tricks with trumps or no-trump. This build plays one deal with natural bidding and duplicate-style scoring.
game.bridge.rule.1: Partners bid for a contract, then the declarer plays both hands while the defenders try to take tricks.
game.bridge.rule.2: Make the contracted number of tricks with the agreed trump suit or no-trump. This build scores one deal.
game.bridge.status_follow: {player} plays to the trick led by {leader}.
game.bridge.hint_auction: Choose a bid higher than the last one, or pass. Three passes after a bid end the auction.
game.bridge.hint_play: Click a card to play it. Follow the led suit while you can.
game.bridge.hint_dummy: Dummy's hand is exposed: click one of dummy's cards to play it for your partner.
game.bridge.log_start: {player} deals the first hand: {cards} cards each.
game.bridge.log_dummy: {player} is dummy; their hand is exposed after the opening lead.
game.bridge.reason.made: The contract was made: the declaring side wins the deal.
game.bridge.reason.down: The contract was defeated: the defenders win the deal.
game.bridge.reason.passed_out: All four players passed: the deal is passed out.
game.bridge.error.unknown_action: That action does not belong to bridge.
game.bridge.error.illegal_action: That bid or card cannot be played now.
